emails.subject: Today's agenda
body: Good morning.
I've attached the agenda planned for this morning.
I've left the slot between 08:30 and 09:00 free in case you need to prepare for the meeting.

emails.subject: RE: Today's agenda
body: Perfect.
Thank you.

emails.subject: Q3 Budget
body: Good morning.
I've attached the latest budget revision.
I'll wait for your approval.

emails.subject: RE: Q3 Budget
body: Reviewed.
You can proceed.

emails.subject: Team photograph
body: I found an old photograph while sorting through a filing cabinet.
It's a little damaged.
Should we keep it?

emails.subject: RE: Team photograph
body: Yes.
Archive it.
There's no need to restore it.

emails.subject: Organisation chart
body: I'm reviewing the updated organisation chart.
There are some small differences compared to the old copy.
I assume they're formatting changes.

emails.subject: RE: Organisation chart
body: Correct.
Keep both versions.

emails.subject: Old documentation
body: While sorting through the Archive, several old folders turned up.
Do you want me to remove the duplicates?

emails.subject: RE: Old documentation
body: No.
Keep everything.
Even the obsolete documents.

emails.subject: HR enquiry
body: Good morning.
An employee has asked about last year's reorganisation.
I wasn't really sure what to tell them.

emails.subject: RE: HR enquiry
body: Only respond with the current documentation.
If they need to consult previous versions, let me know.

emails.subject: Archived contracts
body: I've found several versions of the same contract.
They don't seem to contain the same information.

emails.subject: RE: Archived contracts
body: Don't modify any of them.
Archive them together.

emails.subject: Old photograph
body: I looked at the photograph again.
I could swear I remembered a different team arrangement.
I suppose I'm getting confused.

emails.subject: RE: Old photograph
body: Don't worry.
It's a very old photograph.

emails.subject: Archive organisation
body: There are very few shelves left.
Keeping all the documentation is becoming difficult.

emails.subject: RE: Archive organisation
body: We'll review it.
In the meantime, don't remove any documentation.

emails.subject: Old list
body: I've located a copy of the previous list.
It doesn't exactly match the current one.

emails.subject: RE: Old list
body: Leave it where it was.
We'll talk about it later.

emails.subject: RE: Organisation chart
body: I've compared both versions again.
They still seem different to me.
I couldn't say exactly why.

emails.subject: RE: Organisation chart
body: Don't overthink it.
Always work with the current version.

emails.subject: Visitor enquiry
body: The visitor asked who currently runs the company.
I told them it was you.

emails.subject: RE: Visitor enquiry
body: Perfect.
Let them in when the time comes.

emails.subject: Pending signature
body: I've attached the report for signature.
I can't archive it without your approval.

emails.subject: RE: Pending signature
body: I'll review it before the meeting.

emails.subject: Former employee
body: There's a signature on some documents that I can't identify.
I thought perhaps you might remember it.

emails.subject: RE: Former employee
body: Leave them on my desk.
I'll take a look.

emails.subject: Question
body: Sorry for asking.
Do you remember the reorganisation perfectly?
I'm starting to think I'm the one remembering it incorrectly.

emails.subject: RE: Question
body: Don't worry.
It's normal for details to change over time.

emails.subject: Documentation for the meeting
body: Good morning.
All the documentation is ready.
I've left it on your desk.

emails.subject: RE: Documentation for the meeting
body: Perfect.
Thank you.

emails.subject: Pending signature
body: I've attached the minutes of the last committee meeting.
Only your signature is still pending.
Miguel Ruiz
General Director

emails.subject: RE: Pending signature
body: I'll sign it before 09:00.

emails.subject: Quick question
body: Carlos and I have tried to reconstruct some old records.
We can't reach the same conclusion.
When you have a moment, could you take a look at them?

emails.subject: RE: Quick question
body: Yes.
Leave them in my office.

emails.subject: Archive inventory
body: I've finished the inventory.
There are documents that no one has consulted for years.
Do you want me to move them to external storage?

emails.subject: RE: Archive inventory
body: No.
Everything must remain accessible.

emails.subject: Thank you
body: I found the documentation.
In the end, it was exactly where you told me it was.
Thank you.

emails.subject: RE: Thank you
body: You're welcome.

emails.subject: Budget approved
body: The revised budget has been approved.
You can now continue with the planning.

emails.subject: Staff questions
body: Several employees have asked the same question again.
I don't know what to tell them anymore.

emails.subject: Reminder
body: Pending matters must not be discussed
outside this office.

emails.subject: Meeting
body: We need to talk
before the others start asking questions.

messages.text: The Finance printer is printing a blank page between every page again.
They said I should restart the printer.
Do you also get the feeling that the Archive is bigger than it seems?
It took me ten minutes to find the exit today.
Next time, follow the main corridors.
That's what I'm trying to do.
But I could swear some filing cabinets change places.
Is it acceptable to eat in front of the computer?
What if it's just a sandwich?
I'm preparing the email to wish everyone a happy birthday this month.
I'm always afraid I'll forget someone.
I found a report signed years ago.
It'll be from some former manager.
Although I could swear they still work here.
I found a key inside a folder today.
Put it in lost and found.
I was going to leave it at reception.
At this rate I'll find a car in a box one day.
Let me know if that happens.
I'm going to tell you a secret.
Carlos says he doesn't check social media during work hours.
But every time I walk past his desk, he's reading café reviews.
Inspiration for the eleven o'clock coffee.
I didn't expect you to defend him.
Have you seen Carlos this morning?
He says he wanted to park nearby.
No. He parked where he always does.
Then he got up early for nothing.
I was afraid this moment would come.
How many folders called 'Final' are too many?
There could be a 'Final Definitive 4 Good'.
I've lost the blue filing cabinet again today.
Did you look where you left it yesterday?
Although later it appeared exactly where I remembered.
It's happening to me more and more.
The delivery driver asked me if we actually worked here.
He says he never sees anyone go out for lunch.
I told him we have different schedules.
Although now that I think about it...
I can't remember the last time I went out for lunch either.
The courier came again without warning.
But they said they'll be back tomorrow with more boxes.
Have them leave them at reception.
There won't be enough room this time.
There are names that seem familiar to me.
The strange thing is that I don't know why.
I suppose I've simply been here too long.
I managed to get my inbox down to zero.
I've been doing that for two weeks.
Do we keep the empty filing cabinets?
Even if they don't have a label?
I'm starting to think we don't throw absolutely anything away here.
I've received three holiday requests for the same week.
Carlos says he chose those dates because they're the cheapest.
Clara wants to go at the same time as a friend.
Let's try to make it work.
Laura says she doesn't mind when.
Do you remember last Tuesday's meeting?
They still don't help me remember it.
I've changed the sign at reception.
What did the previous one say?
Yesterday a delivery driver pressed it for almost a minute.
I found an Excel file called 'New'.
Inside it there was another one called 'New 2'.
And inside that, another one called 'New Good'.
Which one was the correct one?
I'm starting to suspect that's your answer to everything.
I could swear I also finished C last week.
I'm thinking about reorganising the Human Resources archive.
It's getting harder to find some things.
But sometimes I get the feeling I'm looking in the wrong place.
Who keeps booking the meeting room and then never shows up?
That's the third time this month.
Cancel the booking if ten minutes pass.
I'll add it to the procedure.
Can I ask you a slightly strange question?
Do you never get the feeling that you've lived the same day twice?
Today I greeted a visitor and for a second I could have sworn I'd already done it.
It happens when we follow the same routine.
I found a folder with three copies of the same report.
The third has a different signature.
I thought you'd want to save space.
Do you know what happened to the new coffee machine?
Now it serves coffee at 3:00 in the morning.
He says it was to test the timer.
Tell him not to touch it again.
I don't understand why we have three almost identical versions.
All three claim to be the latest.
One day I'll have to ask you why we never throw anything away.
The photocopier salesman came back today.
He says our contract ends soon.
I told him the same thing.
Even so, he left me three catalogues.
Do you know who left the microwave dirty again?
Well, someone exploded a pasta container.
But at least I got it off my chest.
How can you be so sure?
I don't know how you find time for everything.

emails.subject: Presentation
body: I have prepared the presentation for this morning.
It is on the Desktop.

emails.subject: RE: Presentation
body: Perfect.
I have updated the figures for the last quarter.

emails.subject: Agenda
body: The meeting will follow the planned agenda.
There will be no need to add any more items.

emails.subject: Projector
body: The projector is already set up.

emails.subject: Update
body: The shared laptop will be updated tonight.
Save any important documents.

emails.subject: Today's visitor
body: Good morning.
We will be receiving a visitor today.
Wait for my call before sending them to the office.
Do not make any exceptions.
Miguel

emails.subject: New employee list
body: Good morning.
Attached is the updated version of the employee list.
Destroy the previous copy when you can.
Thank you.

emails.subject: Cake
body: Are we still doing the birthday thing this afternoon?
I've ordered a chocolate cake.
Don't tell Carlos.

emails.subject: Elevator
body: The elevator will be out of service tomorrow between 09:00 and 11:00.
Sorry for the inconvenience.

emails.subject: Mandatory password change
body: This is a reminder that all passwords must be changed before Friday.
Do not reuse old passwords.

emails.subject: Meeting room
body: Is the meeting room free at 09:00?
I need to prepare some documents.

emails.subject: Material delivery
body: The order will arrive tomorrow.
It includes folders, paper, and toner.

emails.subject: Visitors
body: Reminder.
No one should access the Archive without authorization.
Miguel

emails.subject: Do you remember?
body: A slightly strange question.
Do you remember who occupied desk 4 a few months ago?
I can't seem to remember.

emails.subject: Re: Do you remember?
body: Now that you mention it...
Neither do I.

emails.subject: Organization chart update
body: Good morning.
I've prepared a new version of the organization chart.
The previous one is still in the Archive in case it is needed.
Should we replace it today?
Marta

emails.subject: Re: Organization chart update
body: Yes.
Remove the old version from circulation.
There is no need to destroy it.
Miguel

emails.subject: Who's taking the chairs?
body: Once again, a chair is missing from the meeting room.
If someone took it to another room, please return it.

emails.subject: Team photo
body: I found an old photo of the team.
It's a little bent.
I think I'll leave it in the Archive so it doesn't get lost.

emails.subject: Strange question
body: I don't know if you'll think this is silly...
Do you remember there being a plant next to the window?
I can't picture that area.

emails.subject: Re: Strange question
body: The truth is, neither can I.
But I'd swear it's always been the same.

emails.subject: Equipment inventory
body: This week we will be checking all the computers.
Do not disconnect any equipment.

emails.subject: Filing cabinets
body: The order will include four additional filing cabinets.
We expect delivery tomorrow.

emails.subject: Meeting
body: The meeting scheduled for this morning is still on.
Please be punctual.

emails.subject: Printed list
body: Have you replaced the old copy yet?
I can't find the previous version.

emails.subject: Physical Archive
body: Good morning.
When you have a moment, take the folders marked in blue to the Archive.
The red ones can stay at reception.

emails.subject: Re: Physical Archive
body: The old folders too?
Some of them are quite damaged.

emails.subject: Re: Physical Archive
body: Yes.
Don't throw anything away.

emails.subject: Waiting room
body: There's a lamp flickering.
Let's see if maintenance can come by today.

emails.subject: Disk cleanup
body: Over the weekend we will delete temporary files.
Important documents will not be affected.

emails.subject: Blue box
body: Is there still a blue box with invoices at reception?
I can't find it.

emails.subject: Re: Blue box
body: Yes.
It's behind the counter.

emails.subject: Office access
body: If someone asks for me while I'm in a meeting,
tell them I'm unavailable.
Thank you.

emails.subject: Archive door
body: The lock has jammed again.
It will be checked this afternoon.

emails.subject: A question
body: Do you remember ever changing the layout of Finance?
I don't know why, but I have the impression it used to be different.

emails.subject: Keys
body: Do you know where the keys to the gray filing cabinet are?
They're nowhere to be found.

emails.subject: Re: Keys
body: Look in the second drawer.
They always end up there.

emails.subject: Schedule
body: Please don't schedule any more meetings this morning.
I'll need the office free.

emails.subject: Photograph
body: I looked at the photograph again.
I think I was getting confused.
I suppose we've always been the same people.

emails.subject: Backups
body: The automatic backups have completed successfully.
No action is required.

emails.subject: Filing cabinets
body: I found a folder with old contracts.
I'll leave it in the Archive.

emails.subject: Documentation
body: If anyone asks to consult old documentation,
they must ask me personally.

emails.subject: Former employee
body: I'm reviewing some contracts.
There's a signature I can't identify.
I'll take a closer look later.

emails.subject: Re: Former employee
body: Let me know if you need help.
Maybe Carlos remembers something.

emails.subject: Good morning
body: Thank you for your work over the past few weeks.
See you at the meeting.

messages.text: I'll let you know as soon as they arrive.
There are several people asking about old documents.
One of them insists on consulting the original.
Good morning. We have a registered delivery for Ruiz.
Perfect. You can leave it at reception.
He's in a meeting right now.
If they call asking for me...
Trying to fix the coffee machine.
That also counts as a meeting.
I knew I could count on you.
She's gone down to the Archive.
She spends more time there than at her desk.
She says she always finds something that needs doing.
I don't know how she can find her way around in there.
I'd get lost in five minutes.
Is the projector still causing problems?
Then you'd better not touch it.
How do you manage to remember everyone's name?
I still mix up the suppliers.
You'll stop doing that with time.
I've been here for four years.
Then you just need a little more.
Has anyone come asking for me?
Forget it, I'll tell you later.
Do you know who took my calculator?
Have you looked under the monitor?
That's the third time this month.
There's a really good atmosphere in the office today.
Yes, it's been a while since I've seen everyone this relaxed.
Good morning. We're confirming the usual order.
Are you still at the same number of people?
As far as I know, yes.
I ask because some weeks you consume quite a bit more coffee.
It probably depends on the meetings.
Makes sense. I'll leave it there, then.
There's something that has always amused me.
When someone doesn't know where a document is...
They always end up asking you.
But they don't even ask in the Archive first.
If an entire building ever disappeared, they'd ask you too.
Has Miguel left the office yet?
I need him to sign a document.
Leave it here if you want.
I'd rather give it to him in person.
Although he always says afterward that there was no need to wait.
Who put music on in the meeting room?
I've been listening to jazz for half an hour.
It was worse when she put on classical music.
He hasn't stopped looking at the clock.
I suppose he wants to make a good impression.
Good morning. Are you still having problems with the Archive door?
I didn't know there was a problem.
Then I suppose it's already been fixed.
Can I ask you something silly?
Why do you never let anyone organize the documents in the Archive?
Because it's faster if I do it myself.
It must take you a long time.
I'll never understand how you remember where everything goes.
Every time I go looking for something, I have a hell of a time.
Can you do me a favor?
If anyone asks, I've been looking for a report for five minutes.
And what have you really been doing?
I've been looking for my car keys for five minutes.
Have you looked in your pocket?
I don't want to talk about it.
Have you finished the Human Resources report yet?
I thought it would take you all day.
Have you seen the green filing cabinet?
I'm starting to think they disappear on their own.
That it doesn't even surprise me anymore.
Good morning. We confirm the annual inspection of the access control system.
Have there been any incidents since our last visit?
Then it should be a quick inspection.
Do you need me to prepare anything?
Not yet today, but you never know.
Sometimes I get the feeling that you know this company better than your own home.
I spend a lot of hours here.
It's as if you knew where every folder was before looking for it.
After so many years, you end up learning.
Well, I still haven't seen you make one.
I'll celebrate that day with coffee.
Good morning. We'll make the usual delivery tomorrow.
Do you need to increase the paper order?
Last time you ordered quite a bit more than usual.
I'll check and let you know.
When the visitor arrives, make them wait a few minutes.
And if they ask how long you'll take?
Tell them I'm finishing a meeting.
Has the photocopier technician arrived yet?
He's been saying he's coming for two weeks.
Last week he said he'd been here.
Maybe he came while we were in a meeting.
I moved the plant and the picture.
I'd swear they've always been there.
I remembered them exactly the same.
Good morning. Can we access the offices this afternoon?
The director would have to authorize that.
Yes, the rules are quite strict.
I'm going to pretend this never happened.
